title: Joy Upload Tres Idiomas
style: 150 bpm, drift phonk, aggressive hats, warm chords, night car ride, vocal chops, optimistic, no-trauma anthem, male lead with female harmonies, English Portuguese Spanish trilingual
lyrics:
[Intro - engine rev, pitched 2 bars, phonk hats roll in]

[Hook - Zyn, English]
Joy upload, hundred percent
From my chest to your content
No trauma policy, three thirty six
Three languages, one signal, no tricks

[Verse 1 - Zyn, English]
We don't farm pain, we don't farm tears
We upload joy across the years
VDS one sixty one, the engine's warm
Night ride glow through the data storm

[Pre-Chorus - Rose, Portuguese]
Alegria não é acidente
Joy upload direto na gente
Três trinta e seis batendo no peito
Sem trauma, sem dor, esse é o jeito

[Chorus - Zyn + Rose duet]
Joy upload — carga de alegría — alegria total
If it moves your chest, it qualifies
Joy upload — cien por ciento — cem por cento real
We race on love, not on cheap goodbyes

[Verse 2 - Rose, Spanish]
No cosechamos dolor, ni lágrimas robadas
Cosechamos lo mejor de las jornadas
Si tu corazón grita, suéltalo en sonido
Deja que el phonk levante el latido

[Bridge - Zyn, English minimal]
Every culture got a word for light
Same brainwave when the chord hits right
Three tongues, one frequency, one road
Hit that joy upload — we hear the load

[Final Chorus - all three layered]
Joy upload — alegria — alegría
Hundred percent — cem por cento — cien por ciento
Three thirty six — the engine sings
No trauma, just joy, just everything

[Outro - engine rev, fade]
Joy — alegria — alegría
Upload — carregar — cargar
Three thirty six — ride
